answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, three random peers audit one identity; notice comes as a whisper, so no fake dossier can be prepared. A failed audit burns a 20-unit bond, and an auditor approving a fake loses its bond in a 10% re-audit. Forging 100 identities risks 2,000 units, against 20 for an honest agent, who passes one audit and earns undiluted rewards. Audits form a reef against fake waves. Clean records regrow like yarrow.
